fixed_camera_aim.notes: UNMEASURED: fixed camera on vehicle, only nozzle rotates. Base x forward/y left/z up, pan +z, positive tilt about -y. p_gimbal=R_camera_to_gimbal*p_camera+t_camera_origin_in_gimbal_m. At geometric pan=tilt=0, explicitly measure tilt pivot offset and nozzle exit/direction; zero offsets are valid ONLY when physically measured. Geometric angle=(actuator angle-zero_angle_deg)*positive_direction. Match actuator_reference_id to servo.reference_id and exact limits in actuator status. Match source optical frame, image size and measured stereo calibration ID. No pixel-centering or fixed-distance fallback. Straight nozzle geometry can lock encoder angles but never authorizes water without measured impact calibration.

fixed_camera_landing.notes: UNMEASURED. Separate from moving-camera pixel tables. Measure angular corrections at a complete nominal-pan/nominal-tilt/nozzle-distance grid (at least 2 values per axis). Every row requires a unique measurement_id, measured=true, nominal_pan_deg, nominal_tilt_deg, nozzle_distance_m, angle_correction_deg=[pan_delta,tilt_delta] and actual measured_impact_error_m=[x,y,z]. Every interpolation cell also needs a distinct strictly-interior validation measurement with commanded_angles_deg equal to the interpolated target and actual measured_impact_error_m within the declared acceptance radius. These are actual water tests at the same installation and pump setting; no extrapolation or pressure/gravity guessing. Bind all calibration/profile/reference IDs after measurement. No sample values are supplied because none have been physically measured.

stereo.notes: Use measured GS130W calibration from tools/calibrate_stereo.py. Never replace null with guessed parameters. image_size is single-eye [width,height]. T maps left optical coordinates to right optical coordinates and uses metres.

stereo_runtime.notes: Only mark verified after checking eye order, raw image rotation, exposure synchronization and held-out measured distances. Timestamp pairing alone is not synchronization. Fire mode bounds CPU work; image resolution and the YOLO/preview pipeline remain unchanged.
